name: no-bare-throw
description: Disallow throwing raw errors in framework code — use Result/FrameworkError instead. DISABLED 2026-11-12 after measuring: 234 repo-wide sites, and architecture.md sanctions constructor-invariant throws ('Constructor invariants → may throw (guards type's validity)'). Every remaining site outside types/ is a smart-constructor or internal-assertion guard, so enabling it demands a Result-signature refactor per call site — a design change, not a lint fix. Re-enable per layer once that refactor is scheduled.
fixHint: Return err({ kind: '...', ... }) instead of throwing. Exceptions should only cross boundaries at the imperative shell (executor, runner). If this IS the shell boundary, add a comment explaining why.
